pairs.target: dù chéng bǎ xìn tān zài zhuōshàng , shǒubiān liú zhe jì huái zuórì ràng rén jìxià de nà jù kǒuxìn .
pairs.english: Du Cheng spread the letter on the table, keeping beside him the message Ji Huai had asked to have recorded yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄把信摊在桌上，手边留着纪槐昨日让人记下的那句口信。

pairs.target: dáfù gǎn zài yuē hǎo de rìzi qián sòngdào le , lái sòng de rén yě méi zhī zài ménkǒu hǎnyìshēng . dǒng lǐshì xiě dé hěn mǎn , zuì xiàmiàn lìngfù yìzhāng liǎngzhōu de yònggōng dān , jiào tāmen kàn wán zài qiānshōu .
pairs.english: The answer had arrived before the agreed day, not merely shouted at the door by its bearer. Director Dong had filled the page, attaching a separate two-week staffing form at the bottom and asking them to read before acknowledging receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 答复赶在约好的日子前送到了，来送的人也没只在门口喊一声。董理事写得很满，最下面另附一张两周的用工单，叫他们看完再签收。

pairs.target: jì huái hé xià róng dōu zài , lìngwài liǎngmíng bān gōng zuòzài kàoqiáng chù .
pairs.english: Ji Huai and Xiarong were both there, with two other porters seated by the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐和夏绒都在，另外两名搬工坐在靠墙处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yào ràng dèng , xià róng què jiāng yìzhī hái wēn zhe de bǐng sāi gěi tā , dīshēng shuō xiān chī , bié děnghuìer dùzǐ xiǎng dé gàizhù dù chéng .
pairs.english: Tavi offered his stool, but Xiarong thrust a still-warm flatbread at him and said softly to eat first, before his stomach drowned out Du Cheng.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维要让凳，夏绒却将一只还温着的饼塞给他，低声说先吃，别等会儿肚子响得盖住杜澄。

pairs.target: tā bāi le yíbàn xiǎng hái tā , tā bǎishǒu , shuō zìjǐ de zǎo chī le , búbì ná zhe bànkuài bǐng tóng rén duìzhàng .
pairs.english: He broke off half to give back, but she waved it away: she had eaten already; no need to balance accounts with half a flatbread in hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他掰了一半想还她，她摆手，说自己的早吃了，不必拿着半块饼同人对账。

pairs.target: liǎngzhōu nèi , zhī gěi yǐ hé guò de xiāngdǐ yǔ qīngzǎi pái tuōjià shìyòng .
pairs.english: For two weeks, cradle trials would be scheduled only for verified crate bases and light loads.
pairs.hanzi: 两周内，只给已核过的箱底与轻载排托架试用。

pairs.target: jiēhuò , tuī jià , jiǎnchá huámiàn lìng suàn bānfèi , yuányǒu chāizhuāng réng àn shíjì zuò guò de jiànshù suàn , bùnéng ná yíxiàng dǐ lìng yíxiàng .
pairs.english: Receiving, pushing cradles and checking sliding surfaces would earn separate shift pay; existing unpacking and repacking would still be paid by actual items handled, without offsetting one against the other.
pairs.hanzi: 接货、推架、检查滑面另算班费，原有拆装仍按实际做过的件数算，不能拿一项抵另一项。

pairs.target: yuànyì huànbān de rén xiān lǐngyǒu bàochóu de liànxí shíduàn , zhànwèi hé shǒushì xuéhuì le cái shàng , búshì jīnrì diǎn dào shuí , míngrì biàn yǒngyuǎn yóu shuí zuò .
pairs.english: Anyone wishing to change shifts would first have paid practice time, learning positions and signals before starting. Being chosen today would not assign someone forever from tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 愿意换班的人先领有报酬的练习时段，站位和手势学会了才上，不是今日点到谁，明日便永远由谁做。

pairs.target: dù chéng niàn dào zhèlǐ , kàoqiáng de yígè rén wèn tā , zìjǐ cháng dé shàngshān jiē lìngyìjiā de huò , néng bunéng zhī pái xiàwǔ .
pairs.english: As Du Cheng read this, a man by the wall asked whether he could take afternoons only, since he often had to collect another firm's goods uphill.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄念到这里，靠墙的一个人问他，自己常得上山接另一家的货，能不能只排下午。

pairs.target: jì huái yě táiqǐ tóu , shuō zìjǐ xiān yào liǎngcì zǎobān , qíyú rìzi hái zhàojiù bān jiàn , bié xiān jiāng zhěngzhōu dōu tián gěi tā .
pairs.english: Ji Huai looked up too, saying he wanted two early shifts first and his usual piecework on other days, rather than having the whole week filled for him.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐也抬起头，说自己先要两次早班，其余日子还照旧搬件，别先将整周都填给他。

pairs.target: zhuǎnyùn huì fù de gézi méiyǒu xiě mǎn , dù chéng biàn ná bǐjì zài pángbiān , jiào gèrén bǎ bùnéng lái de shíhòu xiān jiǎng .
pairs.english: The association's grid was not full, so Du Cheng noted their wishes beside it, telling everyone to state unavailable times first.
pairs.hanzi: 转运会附的格子没有写满，杜澄便拿笔记在旁边，叫各人把不能来的时候先讲。

pairs.target: xià róng jiāng dānzi wǎngqián tuī le tuī , shuō zìjǐ bù jiēmǎn bān . míng hòu liǎngrì yǒu dì jiàn , ruò lùshang wǎn huílái , bùnéng jiào biérén děng zhe zìjǐ de shǒushì cái tuī jià .
pairs.english: Xiarong pushed the form forward and said she would not take a full roster. She had deliveries over the next two days; if she returned late, others could not wait for her signal to push the cradle.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒将单子往前推了推，说自己不接满班。明后两日有递件，若路上晚回来，不能叫别人等着自己的手势才推架。

pairs.target: tā yuànyì bǎ yǐ huì de zhànwèi jiàogěi xià yì rén , liànxí gōngshí suànqīng jiù xíng .
pairs.english: She was willing to teach her positions to the next person, provided the practice hours were paid clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 她愿意把已会的站位教给下一人，练习工时算清就行。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánběn yǐwéi tā huì gāoxìng yǒu le dìng xiàlái de huó , tīngdào zhèlǐ cái xiǎngqǐ tái jǐng pù qián nà běn xiǎocè .
pairs.english: Tavi had assumed she would welcome steady work; only now did he remember the little booklet outside the Moss Well shop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原本以为她会高兴有了定下来的活，听到这里才想起苔井铺前那本小册。

pairs.target: gùdìng de gōngshí yě shì yìzhǒng shù zhù jiǎo de shéng , tā zǎo shuō guò zìjǐ xiǎng zǎn shénme , búshì tā shuō shěngxīn biàn tì tā shěng le xīn .
pairs.english: Fixed hours were also a cord around the feet. She had already said what she wanted to build; his calling it reassuring did not make it so for her.
pairs.hanzi: 固定的工时也是一种束住脚的绳，她早说过自己想攒什么，不是他说省心便替她省了心。

pairs.target: jì huái méi quàn tā , dǎo wèn nà liǎngzhāng jíjiàn ruò qiàhǎo yì nán yì běi , qǐ búshì zìjǐ yě dé cháng chū liǎngtiáotuǐ .
pairs.english: Ji Huai did not persuade her otherwise, only asked whether two urgent packets heading north and south would require her to grow two more legs.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐没劝她，倒问那两张急件若恰好一南一北，岂不是自己也得长出两条腿。

pairs.target: tā shuō rújīn yǐjīng yǒu liǎngtiáo , děng zhēn máng dào yòngdéshàng sìtiáo zài zhǎo tā jiè . tā tái le táijiǎo , shuō zhè shuāng guì , bú zhào chāi xiāng de jià jiè .
pairs.english: She said she had two already and would borrow his when busy enough to need four. He lifted his feet and said this pair was expensive, not for hire at unpacking rates.
pairs.hanzi: 她说如今已经有两条，等真忙到用得上四条再找他借。他抬了抬脚，说这双贵，不照拆箱的价借。

pairs.target: xiào guò zhīhòu , tāmen yòu bǎ shuí lái jiēxià yìbān shuō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: After laughing, they discussed who would take the next shift once more.
pairs.hanzi: 笑过之后，他们又把谁来接下一班说了一遍。

pairs.target: jì huái wèn liǎngzhōu guò le zěnmebàn , dù chéng zhǐzhe mòwěi de fùyì rì , shuō nàtiān yào bǎ liǎngtóu de zhuāngxiè hé huí xiāng yíbìng suàn , bùnéng zhī ná fēng zhàn zhèbiān duō sòng jǐ xiāng bào hǎokàn .
pairs.english: Ji Huai asked what happened after two weeks. Du Cheng pointed to the review date at the end: they would count loading, unloading and return crates at both ends together, not merely report extra Wind Trestle carriages to look good.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐问两周过了怎么办，杜澄指着末尾的复议日，说那天要把两头的装卸和回箱一并算，不能只拿风栈这边多送几厢报好看。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén jiāng liǎngzhōu xiěchéng le wǎnghòu quán wěn , kě zhècì zhǐ shàng quèshí duō le gè rénxuǎn guò de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Nobody wrote two weeks as permanent security, but this time the paper truly included positions people had chosen themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人将两周写成了往后全稳，可这次纸上确实多了各人选过的位置。

pairs.target: wēn xiù bǎ shí bèi nà zhāng huí xiāng tú fàngdào pángbiān , jiǎngmíng tuōjià réng liúzài nàbiān cè wū , méiyǒu chāi , lìngwài zuò yífù yě hái zhǐshì bànfǎ zhīyī .
pairs.english: Wenxiu placed Shibei's return-crate drawing beside it and explained that the cradle remained intact in the side room there; making another was still only one option.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫把石背那张回箱图放到旁边，讲明托架仍留在那边侧屋，没有拆，另外做一副也还只是办法之一。

pairs.target: dù chéng biàn zài yònggōng dān de bèimiàn tiān le huí jià zhè yíxiàng wèi jì , jiào rén míngzǎo yìqǐ sònggěi dǒng lǐshì .
pairs.english: Du Cheng added “cradle returns not yet counted” to the back of the staffing form, to be sent to Director Dong together tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄便在用工单的背面添了回架这一项未计，叫人明早一起送给董理事。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ xīn chū de máfán cáng qǐlái , miǎnde gāng zhēng lái de bānfèi yòu zài lìngyìtóu bèi dàngchéng bái shěng de .
pairs.english: He did not hide the new complication, lest the shift pay just won be treated at the other end as money saved for nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把新出的麻烦藏起来，免得刚争来的班费又在另一头被当成白省的。

pairs.target: sàn shí , jiēshàng yǐjīng liàng qǐ diàn dēng . jì huái qù jiē jiālǐrén liú de fàn , xià róng háiyào jiāo yìzhāng shōutiáo , wēn xiù zé jiāng nà bànkuài méi chī wán de bǐng názǒu , shuō tǎ wéi ruò zài tuīràng , míngzǎo biàn zhī shèng zhǐ néng chī .
pairs.english: When they dispersed, shop lights were on. Ji Huai went for the meal his family had kept, Xiarong had another receipt to deliver, and Wenxiu took the half-eaten flatbread, saying if Tavi kept offering it away, only paper would remain to eat tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 散时，街上已经亮起店灯。纪槐去接家里人留的饭，夏绒还要交一张收条，温岫则将那半块没吃完的饼拿走，说塔维若再推让，明早便只剩纸能吃。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái fāxiànzìjǐ cóng jìnmén qǐ , yìzhí bǎ bǐng zuàn zài shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Only then did he realize he had held the bread ever since entering.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才发现自己从进门起，一直把饼攥在手里。

pairs.target: huí kǎobǐng pù hòu , tā méi lìkè shànglóu , wèn ruǎn héng zìjǐ néng bunéng huàn yífù jiājù xué zhe kàn . búshì wēn xiù nà yífù , yě búshì qù shì jiù táishàng de tiě .
pairs.english: Back at the bakery, he did not go upstairs at once, but asked Ruan Heng if he could learn with another fixture. Not Wenxiu's, nor an attempt on the old platform iron.
pairs.hanzi: 回烤饼铺后，他没立刻上楼，问阮衡自己能不能换一副夹具学着看。不是温岫那一副，也不是去试旧台上的铁。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng réng yòng shúxī de yíduì tiě jiàn , zhī gǎiliáng cè bì de láilù , kànkàn zìjǐ néngfǒu xiān rènchū zhīdiǎn biàn le zhīhòu , nǎlǐ dòng dé duō , nǎlǐ qíshí méiyǒu duō jiè .
pairs.english: He wanted to keep the familiar iron pair and change only the measuring arm's approach, to see if he could first recognize where a changed pivot produced more motion without actually borrowing more.
pairs.hanzi: 他想仍用熟悉的一对铁件，只改量测臂的来路，看看自己能否先认出支点变了之后，哪里动得多，哪里其实没有多借。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tīng wán , jiào tā huà chūlái . tǎ wéi pāzài hái mòshōu jìng de zhuōshàng , huà le liǎnggè wèizhì , yòu bǎshǒu tiē chù miàn hé huílái shōu zhǐ de kòngxì liú kāi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng told him to draw it. Leaning over the uncleared table, Tavi drew two positions and left space for hand contact and returning to cancel.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡听完，叫他画出来。塔维趴在还没收净的桌上，画了两个位置，又把手贴触面和回来收止的空隙留开。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng tì tā shāndiào yìgēn huì pèng dǎng kuài de héngtiáo , xiě shàng zhī shēnqǐng jiēchù liànxí , bú liàn lí shǒu yúliú , pǔtōng hé liáng xiān zuò , bù děngyú zhǔnxǔ shīshù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng removed a crosspiece that would strike a stop and wrote: request contact practice only, no hands-off residue. Ordinary checks first did not mean permission to cast.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡替他删掉一根会碰挡块的横条，写上只申请接触练习，不练离手余留，普通核量先做，不等于准许施术。

pairs.target: tāmen jiāng tú hé yuán jiājù de biānhào yìtóng xiě jìn jǐ wéi lǎoshī de xìn , tǎ wéi fù guò yóufèi , jiāogěi diànlǐ de rén , děng xià yìbān yóuchē shōuzǒu .
pairs.english: They put the drawing and original fixture number together in a letter to Instructor Vey. Tavi paid postage and left it with the shopkeeper for the next mail cart.
pairs.hanzi: 他们将图和原夹具的编号一同写进给维老师的信，塔维付过邮费，交给店里的人，等下一班邮车收走。

pairs.target: shànglóu shí , tā cóng ménfèng lǐ kànjiàn xià róng yánjiē zǒu guòqù , biǎn pídài tiē zài bèishàng , shēnhòu méiyǒu yìzhāng tì tā páimǎn le gézi de zhǐ . tā jiāng zìjǐ nà zhāng huà liúzài zhěnbiān , míng zǎoxiān liáng yíbiàn , bù jí zhe jiào tā biàn .
pairs.english: On his way upstairs he saw Xiarong walking along the street through the doorway, her flat leather bag against her back, with no fully assigned grid following her. He left his drawing by his pillow: measure first tomorrow morning, without hurrying to make anything change.
pairs.hanzi:
上楼时，他从门缝里看见夏绒沿街走过去，扁皮袋贴在背上，身后没有一张替她排满了格子的纸。
他将自己那张画留在枕边，明早先量一遍，不急着叫它变。
